feed.title: An ESPN host is set to make live fantasy picks from 35,000 feet on United

This recall affects over 4 million vehicles in total, with Tesla accounting for the largest portion. The move addresses a problem that has been linked to deadly consequences.

feed.title: AbbVie will present 90% lung cancer response data; the treatment remains investigational
feed.summary: AbbVie announced it will present new data at the 2026 World Conference on Lung Cancer (WCLC) on its investigational lung cancer treatments. Key findings include a 90% objective response rate for ABBV-1480 plus chemotherapy in squamous NSCLC and promising data for telisotuzumab adizutecan (Temab-A) and ABBV-706. Despite positive data, the treatments remain investigational and are not yet approved by health authorities.

feed.title: Tesla said fatal Autopilot crash data didn't exist — a $15K bug bounty hacker proved it did, costing Tesla $243 million
feed.summary: A lawsuit against Tesla resulted in a $243 million payout after a hacker proved the company had access to fatal Autopilot crash data, despite claiming otherwise. This incident raises concerns about Tesla's transparency and readiness for its fully autonomous Cybercab rollout, especially as self-driving Teslas continue to be involved in high-profile crashes. The hacker's actions highlighted a critical vulnerability and Tesla's alleged attempts to obscure data related to Autopilot system failures.

feed.title: Delta Air Lines Removes Aircraft From Service At Hartsfield-Jackson As Carrier Nears The Top For Canceled Flights
feed.summary: A Delta Air Lines flight from Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport to Raleigh-Durham was removed from service due to a right-engine mechanical issue, causing significant delays for 173 passengers. This incident contributed to widespread disruptions for Delta, which faced numerous delays and cancellations on Thursday and Friday, largely due to severe weather and FAA ground stops in the Northeast. Delta is currently leading U.S. carriers in flight delays and is among the top three for cancellations, prompting the airline to offer flexible rebooking options for affected Northeast customers.

This remodel is one of approximately 15 stores being updated this year, coinciding with the company's acquisition of Giant Eagle and the closure of some other Kroger and Jay C Food Stores locations in Indiana.

feed.title: One year after protest, organizers say Microsoft still needs to cut ties with Israeli military
feed.summary: One year after protests, organizers from "No Azure for Apartheid" are still calling for Microsoft to sever all ties with the Israeli military, claiming the company's technology was used for mass surveillance in Gaza. While Microsoft did cut some cloud services to an Israeli military unit following earlier protests, activists argue that further action is needed. Former Microsoft and Amazon employees, who were arrested during last year's demonstrations, emphasize the importance of continued pressure on tech executives.
